entry_state: Repurchase allocation and amendment-date inducement differ; announcement, legal release and share delivery need separate dates. Cash-flow hedge effectiveness uses cumulative designated values; settlement does not itself release the reserve. Inventory basis transfer and interest recycling differ. A fair-value debt hedge instead changes carrying value and profit, with later amortisation still to follow.
exit_state: Fair-value hedge adjustments require a recalculated rate; benchmark reform retains conditional continuity rather than resetting reserves. Option premium cost and intrinsic protection use separate reserves and release rules. The actual strike100 and hedged price110 now produce different intrinsic gains; the aligned time-value and profit formulas are introduced but their remaining interpretation follows.
findings: Recalculated10% on carrying110 reaches121; reusing21% would over-accrete the liability. Benchmark equivalence requires more than one matching coupon.
